newsitem.title: USA: Antitrust waiting period for Vencor expires.
newsitem.headline: Antitrust waiting period for Vencor expires.

text.p: Vencor Inc said on Thursday that the Hart-Scott-Rodino antitrust waiting period expired for its proposed acquisition of Transitional Hospitals Corp, and that it delivered a definitive merger agreement to Transitional.
Under the terms of the proposed agreement, Vencor's wholly owned subsidiary, LV Acquisition Corp, would purchase all Transitional's outstanding shares for at $16 apiece.
The tender offer has been extended until June 19.

In a separate news release, Transitional, based in Las Vegas, said it would terminate an agreement with privately held Select Medical Corp under which Select would have acquired Transitional for $14.55 per share.
